issues.on_page: p4 statement prints the Inheritance Tax column's 1,002,463 on the 'Miscellaneous' row; p7 budget schedule prints the same 1,002,463 as 'Inheritance Tax'
issues.issue: Split of the statement's Miscellaneous line is backed by a printed breakdown (p7), so it meets the tax-split rule. But the statement itself labels it Miscellaneous, so this is a judgment call between the as-printed rule and the tax-split rule. Arithmetic is exact (1,002,463 + 835,259 = 1,837,722).
